User: Hello, I had a bad experience with the Winegard DS-2000 Universal 22-inch Tower Mount for Off-Air TV Antennas (1.5in Diameter Mount Pipe) and I'd like to share my review. (Review: Geez, this was advertised as a package with the TaoTronics TT-OA01 Amplified VHF / UHF Outdoor HDTV Antenna. It is NOT! The antenna pole adapter on the antenna itself will accommodate a 3/4" pipe (PVC or metal). The mounting tube on the end of the Winegard DS-2000 needs something that will fit snuggly into a 1.485" tube. There is no such animal. A 1" pipe has an OD of 1.32" and 1 1/4" pipe is 1.66". The 1" pipe will not fit into the antenna mount and it fits very, very loosely into the Winegard mount. You have to wrap a lot of electrical tape to get a snug fit, then go buy a bell housing adapter to connect the 1" pipe to the 3/4"pipe needed on the antenna. When you do this you have to remember to run your ground wire from above the antenna mount to the nearest grounding point. If you count on running a ground wire from the Winegard then the antenna will be isolated from ground by the electrical tape and it becomes a highly charged piece of metal. Kaboom in a lightning storm. What a mess! Winegard should have used a 1.32" or 1.66" ID tube for ease of use.)
